sn35.21:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– yo bhikkhave, cakkhussa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṃ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
sn35.21:1.6: yo manassa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo, dukkhasseso uppādo, rogānaṃ ṭhiti, jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo.
sn35.21:2.1: yo ca kho bhikkhave, cakkhussa nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo. dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṃ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthagamo.
sn35.21:2.2: yo sotassa nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo. dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṃ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthagamo.
sn35.21:2.6: yo manassa nirodho vūpasamo atthagamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṃ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthagamoti.
